text:
Type: off-white metal bell pendant lamp
Use: light over a dining table, kitchen island or counter; dining room, kitchen, living room
Style: farmhouse, industrial, retro
Materials: off-white powder-coated steel shade, brass-tone socket, black and white braided textile cord, white ceiling cup
Colors: off-white, brass, black and white cord
Shape: rounded bell shade with a short neck and wide flared rim, brass collar with wing details, hangs on a patterned cord, medium size, vintage factory outline
Feel: nostalgic, warm, crafted, friendly
Goes with: warm wood, white tiles, brass, black accents; farmhouse, industrial or Scandinavian kitchens and dining rooms

product.name: RANARP
product.description: Gives a directed light; good for lighting up for example dining tables or bar tops.
